metadata.creator: CINE DOCS.
metadata.description:
This the complete "Buzz Lightyear of Star Command" cartoon (tv show + movie) in a (almost) high-quality VHS rips. 


Every episode was ripped from the fan-made DVD by collectors Times Forgotten (Buy their DVD to support them). But three of the episodes (Conspiracy, Super Nova, Inside Job) are still in a lower quality, due to not being included in the box set.


I also included a .rar file with tie-in comics, the movie DVD featurettes, and promo videos for the Toon Disney webisite. I didn't included the show tie-in games due to being too much for a single bonus .rar that will probally pass unnoticed by most.


Sorry for taking so long to upload the second half of the show. Enjoy!

reviews.reviewtitle: Do you happen to have any more episodes?
reviews.reviewbody:
Hi. This is a neat assortment of episodes you got here in HQ. I was wondering if you have the rest of the BLoSC episodes in the same quality as all the ones you have here (excluding "Inside Job")? 

I know that these were recorded around 2000/2001 and seen some clips of the episodes online (such as "Devolutionaries" for example) with the same Toon Disney watermark as almost all these episodes you currently have here.

I mean, if you don't, that's absolutely fine. Still, thanks for uploading!

reviews.reviewbody: Please Upload The Rest Of The Seasons plzzzzz
cause i see nothing

(fresh edit) all the episodes are not here... it is taking long to rip and upload them? here's a link to a g drive that i have of an official dvd rip of the pilot movie https://drive.google.com/file/d/1nQ8vkuo5ZniwN6q8Y6ku1iu_uGVqRTwI/view?usp=drive_link

for months it isn't complete
@PixarFan’s Archive Corner yes I have it, but for some reason, I didn't upload them. Sorry for the late response, I am uploading them right now :)

Great quality, but is there any chance you can upload the rest of the episodes? 

From what I have gathered, 2 seasons aired, the first one had 49 episodes, and the second one had 13 episodes, however there is only 38 here. In total there should be 62 episodes and the movie (unless some of these files contain multiple episodes?). 

I saw your previous reply to Pixar Archive where you said the upload didn't complete, so I am wondering if this happened again? Anyways great work, and this is the only release out there that has subtitles included so it is really appreciated. Hopefully you have the missing episodes as well so this collection can be complete!

reviews.reviewbody: Aside from the movie and the 3 episodes that have modified pitch and bad quality I want to thank you for these episodes. I still have my dvd copy of the movie so I don't have to worry about the audio. I will need to modify the audio on the 3 episodes you listed and just have to live with the quality until they show up online/streaming services or until someone can fix the quality. So thank you again for these.

reviews.reviewtitle: Buzz Lightyear of Star Command - Complete Series (HD TVRip)
reviews.reviewbody: This is too cool!
Keep it up! I love this show, and I hope it gets on Disney+ soon!

First of all, let me just say that I think it's totally awesome that this series is on the Internet Archive. But why does it have a content warning? This is a family-friendly show; there's nothing offensive in it.

I loved this show when I was a kid. It is a shame why Pixar would disown the series and have their own version of the Buzz Lightyear Movie.

I have watched all the episodes.
